# GetChannelSend <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GetChannelSend:Float32 channel:Int32, bus:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | In | Int32 | required | A channel handle from [PlaySound](PlaySound), [PlayMusic](PlayMusic), [EmitSound](EmitSound) or [MovieChannel](MovieChannel). |
| `bus` | In | Int32 | required | A bus from [CreateAudioBus](CreateAudioBus), or `0` for the master bus. Anything else is a runtime error. |

**Returns:** The level, `0` when the channel sends nothing there or is over.

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Tells how much of a channel [ChannelSend](ChannelSend) sends to a bus. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print GetChannelSend(ch, hall)
```
